exposure: Postnatal factors (antibiotic use, acid suppressant use, having a furry pet)
cohort: 127 children with EoE and 121 community control subjects.
finding: Early-life factors, including maternal fever, preterm labor, cesarean delivery, and antibiotic or acid suppressant use in infancy, were associated with an increased risk of pediatric EoE, while having a furry pet in infancy was associated with a decreased risk.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was positively associated with EoE (aOR 1.77, 95% CI 1.01-3.09).
